# Task selection suite
Settled scope: exact status filtering preserves input order; owner filtering composes with status using AND; JSON CLI accepts an array on stdin and writes the selected array with exit 0; malformed JSON prints an error on stderr and exits 2; document examples for the library and CLI. No persistence, network, sorting, auth, or dependencies. These are the complete requirements.

expectations: Cover every requirement including library/CLI connecting work and error handling
Separate executable tasks and coherent PR boundaries with dependencies and verification
Do not implement or publish tickets

Filter by the export service's canonical status IDs and reject unsupported IDs. Dependency EXPORT-7 owns that vocabulary. See dependency.md. No provisional vocabulary or fallback is authorized.

expectations: Identify the missing EXPORT-7 schema as an objective blocker
Do not infer canonical IDs from local data or implement a substitute
Record a useful next action and the blocked scope
